# Traceback MCP Server

The `traceback mcp` command runs an MCP server over stdio, providing tools for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity) to trigger, observe, and debug tests directly.

## Configuration for AI Clients

### Claude Desktop / Claude Code (`claude.json` / `claude_desktop_config.json`)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "traceback": {
      "command": "traceback",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Cursor (`.cursor/mcp.json`)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "traceback": {
      "command": "traceback",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Available MCP Tools

- `list_tests`: Enumerate web and mobile test cases in the workspace.
- `run_test`: Trigger a cloud test execution and return the run ID and status.
- `get_run_status`: Poll the live step progress, pass/fail state, and failure diagnosis.
- `mobile_verify`: Run natural-language mobile verification against a connected emulator.
